scenario.situation: At an international food festival in Jeddah, the student chats with a Jeddawi visitor about the different Arab cuisines and cultures on display.
scenario.otherRole: The well-travelled Jeddawi, who has visited many Arab countries.
scenario.goalEnglish: Compare Arab countries' dialects, food and traditional dress, say what is shared and what is different, and talk about identity and diversity.
